C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until January 29, 2001, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
